name: Estimate Summary
description: Estimate workbook. Engine fills the Cover totals, Roles sheet (one row per role), and Assumptions sheet (engine assumptions text). AI writes a short estimate-overview narrative explaining the totals + drivers + confidence — a leadership read that complements the structured numbers.

sections.title: Estimate overview
sections.purpose: 2–4 sentences explaining the estimate at a glance: what scenario it represents, what's driving the cost range, the biggest sensitivities, and a one-line confidence call. Prose, not bullets. No role-by-role detail (the Roles sheet covers that).
